verdict.rationale: Attio ships 'Ask Attio', a first-party natural-language interface. It is documented to search, update and create records, draft follow-ups, schedule next steps, query live pipeline data, and build workflows from a described goal. Separately, a documented official MCP server lets users drive the workspace from Claude or ChatGPT. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on Ask Attio's command scope and limits (the evidence is mostly marketing-page claims), and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as described.
